Metadata.description: Fullstack developer with experience in PHP, Laravel, React, Next.js, Vue and Node. Focused on building solid, accessible and well-tested web applications.

Home.subtitle: I build end-to-end web applications with PHP, Laravel, Node, React and Next.js. I care about clean code, performance and accessible experiences.

highlights.backendDesc: REST APIs and services in Laravel, Node and Express. Data modeling with MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
highlights.frontendDesc: Accessible, fast UIs with React, Next.js, Vue and Tailwind. Thoughtful UX, responsive by default.
highlights.devopsDesc: Docker, CI/CD, deploys on Netlify and Vercel. Testing, monitoring and basic observability.

About.title: About me
About.lead: I'm a fullstack developer passionate about building useful, well-crafted software.
paragraphs: I started writing HTML and CSS out of curiosity and ended up loving the whole craft: from modeling a database to polishing the last pixel of an interface.

My main focus is the backend with PHP and Laravel, complemented with relational databases (MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB). On the client side I work with React, Next.js, Vue and Tailwind.
I'm motivated by collaborating with teams, writing code others can read effortlessly, and shipping products that solve real problems.
